purpose: Educational metadata for rule-based diagnoses. Rules remain evidence-driven in recommendations.py.

entries.verify: Inspect the waveform and bypass the final limiter.
Measure again with a true-peak meter after codec preview.
Compare loudness-matched, not at raw playback level.
Check whether wide dynamics are intentional before changing gain.
Bypass bus compression and compare at matched loudness.
Inspect short-term loudness and transients by song section.
Audition in mono and inspect M/S routing.
Check chorus, Haas delays and stereo reverb in mono.
Compare the side channel and mono fold-down.
Confirm that mono delivery is intentional.
Loudness-match a reference before considering EQ.
Check multiple playback systems and codec preview.
Use references and stems to locate the contributing source.
Tap tempo or inspect the DAW grid manually.
Treat as information for ambient or rubato material.
